CustomField.description:
Text formula that constructs a sentence explaining the relationship between the two Contacts
Caution: This field was installed from an Education Trailblazers Association solution. Before editing, ensure changes won't break automation.
CustomField.formula: TEXT(Contact.Salutation) + " " + Contact.FirstName + " " + Contact.LastName + " is " + TEXT(RelatedContact.Salutation) + " " + RelatedContact.FirstName + " " + RelatedContact.LastName + "'s " + PartyRoleRelation.RoleName
CustomField.inlineHelpText: A sentence that clarifies who's who in the Relationship. For example, "'s " Joe Ada is Sara Cordova's employer."'s " This field is read-only.
CustomField.label: Relationship Explanation
